questions.question: Which is the tallest animal in the world?
questions.hint: A giraffe can grow over 5.5 meters (18 feet) tall, making it the tallest living animal.

questions.question: Which part of a plant absorbs water from the soil?
questions.hint: Roots anchor the plant and absorb water and nutrients from the soil.

questions.question: Which superhero is also known as the 'Caped Crusader'?
questions.hint: Batman is often called the Caped Crusader because of his cape and dedication to fighting crime.

questions.question: Which movie features the snowman named Olaf?
questions.hint: Olaf is the cheerful snowman created by Elsa's magic in Frozen.

questions.question: What number should you dial for emergency services in many European countries?
questions.hint: 112 is the standard emergency number used across most European countries.

questions.question: Which profession is mainly responsible for putting out fires?
questions.hint: Firefighters protect people and property by extinguishing fires and responding to emergencies.

questions.question: Which famous ship sank after hitting an iceberg in 1912?
questions.hint: The RMS Titanic sank during its maiden voyage across the Atlantic Ocean.

questions.question: Which explorer is credited with reaching the Americas in 1492?
questions.hint: Christopher Columbus crossed the Atlantic Ocean in 1492 under the Spanish crown.

questions.question: Which country hosted the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
questions.hint: Qatar became the first Middle Eastern country to host the FIFA World Cup.

questions.question: In basketball, how many points is a free throw worth?
questions.hint: Each successful free throw awards one point to the team.

questions.question: Which is the largest continent by land area?
questions.hint: Asia covers about 30% of Earth's land area and is home to more than half of the world's population.

questions.question: Which country is known as the Land of the Rising Sun?
questions.hint: Japan is called the Land of the Rising Sun because it lies east of mainland Asia.

questions.question: Which organ pumps blood throughout the human body?
questions.hint: The heart pumps oxygen-rich blood to every part of the body through the circulatory system.

questions.question: Which vitamin is mainly produced by the body when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.hint: Sunlight helps the skin produce Vitamin D, which is important for healthy bones.

questions.question: Which country is famous for the martial art of karate?
questions.hint: Karate originated in Okinawa, Japan, and is now practiced around the world.

questions.question: Which festival is known as the 'Festival of Lights' in India?
questions.hint: Diwali celebrates the victory of light over darkness and is one of India's biggest festivals.

questions.question: Which animal is the largest mammal on Earth?
questions.hint: The blue whale is the largest animal known to have ever lived on Earth.

questions.question: Which country has the largest population in the world (as of recent years)?
questions.hint: India recently became the world's most populous country, surpassing China.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula for water?
questions.hint: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

questions.question: Which city is famous for the ancient Colosseum?
questions.hint: The Colosseum in Rome is one of the greatest architectural achievements of the ancient Roman Empire.
